item.description:
The bells learn the scale. Each minute of a Breathe session rings one step up the pentatonic, and the final bell is the octave coming home — you can hear where you are without counting. They ring longer and a touch louder too.

"Use my original wording" gains its own shortcut — Ctrl+Option+Z. The panel loses its front-page labels and reads cleaner for it; Settings reorders to use-first.

Draft writes like writing. No more "gonna" or "yeah" in finished prose. Long, pause-heavy dictations come back mended as one passage instead of fragments, and a stray "#" the engine sometimes coughs up is cleaned away.
